# THE JIMMY LAB

THE JIMMY LAB is a digital agency crafting immersive websites, web applications and interactive experiences. Based in Islamabad, Pakistan. Founded in 2013. Serving clients in the USA, UK, Europe and the Gulf.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/web-development): Fast, secure and scalable web applications built around your business.
- [UI/UX Design](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/ui-ux-design): Interfaces that feel effortless — designed from research, not guesswork.
- [Mobile Development](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/mobile-development): Mobile experiences that feel native, ship fast and scale with your users.
- [E-Commerce](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/e-commerce): Storefronts built to convert — fast, flexible and beautiful at every step.
- [AI Solutions](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/ai-solutions): Turn your data and workflows into intelligent, automated products.
- [Web Animation](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/web-animation): Motion that guides, delights and sets your brand apart.
- [Logo Design & Branding](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/logo-design-branding): A mark people remember, and a brand system that holds up everywhere it lands.
- [2D/3D Graphic Design](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/graphic-design-2d-3d): Custom 2D illustration and 3D renders — no stock clichés, ever.
- [1:1 Consultation & Training](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/consultation-training): Senior expertise on tap — unblock your team without hiring for it.
- [SEO & Website Optimization](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/seo-website-optimization): Get found on Google, load fast everywhere, and turn search traffic into enquiries.
- [Maintenance & Support](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/maintenance-support): Never worry about updates, downtime or broken pages again.
- [Integration & Automation](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/integration-automation): Less copy-paste, fewer dropped leads, more time for real work.
- [Website Redesign & Migration](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/website-redesign-migration): New design, same traffic — a relaunch done properly.
- [Code Review & Technical Audit](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/code-review-technical-audit): Know exactly where your code stands — before it becomes a problem.

## Journal

- [Modern Scroll-Linked Animation Techniques](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/journal/scroll-animation-techniques) (Motion): A deep dive into building performant, responsive scroll animations with the vanilla Motion library in Astro.
- [Why Astro is the Ultimate Framework for Portfolios](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/journal/astro-for-portfolios) (Engineering): How Astro's island architecture and zero-JS output by default make it the perfect tool for fast creative portfolios.
- [Core Principles of Functional Motion Design](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/journal/motion-design-principles) (Motion): Why animation in web design is a functional tool, not just an aesthetic embellishment, and how to apply it.
- [AI-Assisted Development in 2026: Speed Without Losing Craft](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/journal/ai-assisted-development-2026) (AI): AI tools now write a large share of first drafts. The craft has moved from typing code to reviewing it, and that changes how a good team works.
- [Core Web Vitals in 2026: What Actually Moves the Score](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/journal/core-web-vitals-2026) (Performance): Most sites fail the same few checks for the same few reasons. Here is the short list of fixes that move the score, in order.
- [Interactive 3D on the Web Without Killing Performance](https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/journal/interactive-3d-without-slowing-down) (Interactive): 3D on a website grabs attention, but it is also the fastest way to drain a phone battery. Here is how to keep the wow and lose the cost.

## Service details

### Web Development — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/web-development

Production-grade websites and web applications engineered to scale from day one.

Q: How long does a typical web project take?
A: A marketing site typically takes 2–4 weeks, while a full web application can take 6–16 weeks depending on scope and complexity.

Q: Do you provide ongoing support?
A: Yes — we offer maintenance and retainer packages covering updates, monitoring and new feature development.

Q: Can you work with our existing codebase?
A: Absolutely. We regularly audit, refactor and extend existing React, Node.js and PHP codebases.

### UI/UX Design — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/ui-ux-design

Pixel-perfect interfaces and design systems crafted around real user behaviour.

Q: Do you also implement the designs?
A: Yes — our designers and engineers work side-by-side, so the shipped product matches the design pixel-for-pixel.

Q: Can you redesign our existing product?
A: Absolutely. We start with a UX audit, then redesign and improve without disrupting your current flow.

Q: What tools do you use?
A: Figma is our primary tool, with Framer for high-fidelity prototypes and After Effects for motion studies.

### Mobile Development — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/mobile-development

Native-quality mobile apps for iOS and Android built with modern cross-platform tooling.

Q: Native or cross-platform?
A: For most products, cross-platform (React Native/Flutter) gives the best speed-to-market and cost, while still feeling native.

Q: Can you take our app to the store?
A: Yes — we handle the full submission process for both the App Store and Google Play.

Q: Do you build MVPs?
A: Definitely. MVPs are our speciality — a lean, focused first release to validate your idea fast.

### E-Commerce — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/e-commerce

High-converting storefronts and headless commerce builds that turn browsers into buyers.

Q: Shopify or custom?
A: It depends on your needs. Shopify is great for speed-to-market; a headless build gives maximum flexibility and performance.

Q: Can you migrate our existing store?
A: Yes — we migrate products, customers and orders with zero downtime and SEO preserved.

Q: Do you handle payments?
A: We integrate Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay and local payment gateways, plus subscription billing.

### AI Solutions — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/ai-solutions

AI-powered products, automations and copilots that put intelligence to work for your business.

Q: What can AI actually do for my business?
A: It depends on your data and workflows — but common wins are automating support, document processing, content and data analysis.

Q: Is our data kept private?
A: Yes. We can use private models, on-prem hosting and strict data isolation depending on your compliance needs.

Q: How do you measure success?
A: We define clear metrics up front — time saved, cost reduced, or revenue generated — and report against them.

### Web Animation — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/web-animation

Scroll-driven, 2D & 3D motion that makes interfaces feel alive and unforgettable.

Q: Will animation slow my site down?
A: No — we optimise every animation for performance and respect reduced-motion preferences for accessibility.

Q: Can you animate an existing site?
A: Yes. We can add scroll experiences, interactions and motion to your current product without a rebuild.

Q: Do you do 3D product configurators?
A: Absolutely — interactive 3D configurators are one of our signature offerings.

### Logo Design & Branding — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/logo-design-branding

Distinctive logos and complete brand systems that make you instantly recognisable everywhere.

Q: How many concepts do we get?
A: We present two to three distinct strategic directions, then refine the chosen route together until it's right.

Q: Do you redesign existing logos?
A: Yes — evolutionary refreshes that keep your equity while modernising the mark are a big part of our work.

Q: What files do we receive?
A: Full vector and raster suites, plus favicon, app icons and a printable brand guidelines document.

### 2D/3D Graphic Design — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/graphic-design-2d-3d

Illustration, motion graphics and 3D visuals that give your product a visual language of its own.

Q: Can 3D models run on our website?
A: Yes — we deliver Draco-compressed glTF models tuned for Three.js, typically under 2 MB per scene.

Q: Do you work from our sketches?
A: Absolutely. Rough sketches, moodboards or napkins — we can start from anything and professionalise it.

Q: Who owns the artwork?
A: You do. Full commercial rights transfer on final payment, including source files.

### 1:1 Consultation & Training — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/consultation-training

Focused 1-on-1 guidance, code reviews and hands-on training for teams and individuals.

Q: How do sessions work?
A: 60 or 90 minute video calls, screen-share first. You leave each session with notes and next steps.

Q: Can you train our whole team?
A: Yes — private cohort workshops, scheduled around your sprints, using your own codebase as the curriculum.

Q: Do you offer ongoing retainers?
A: We keep a limited number of monthly advisory slots for continued guidance between builds.

### SEO & Website Optimization — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/seo-website-optimization

Higher rankings, faster pages and more organic traffic — technical SEO and performance work that compounds over time.

Q: How long before SEO results show?
A: Technical and speed fixes usually show within weeks; ranking and traffic growth typically builds over 2–3 months.

Q: Do you write content too?
A: We map keywords and optimise existing pages, and can brief or produce SEO content as part of a package.

Q: Is this a one-time job or ongoing?
A: Both — a one-time audit and fix, or a monthly retainer for continuous optimisation and reporting.

### Maintenance & Support — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/maintenance-support

Your site stays fast, secure and up to date — updates, monitoring, backups and fixes handled for you.

Q: What counts as a small fix?
A: Text and image changes, broken links, layout bugs and small feature tweaks — anything that fits in a short session.

Q: Do you support sites you did not build?
A: Yes — we start with a quick health check, then take over maintenance from there.

Q: Can I cancel anytime?
A: Yes — maintenance is month to month, with your backups and documentation handed over if you leave.

### Integration & Automation — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/integration-automation

Connect your tools and automate the busywork — CRMs, forms, payments and workflows that run themselves.

Q: Which tools can you connect?
A: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Stripe, Calendly, email platforms and most tools with an API or webhook — tell us your stack and we will map it.

Q: What if an automation breaks?
A: Every flow has error alerts, and maintenance clients get priority fixes — nothing fails silently for weeks.

Q: Do I need a CRM first?
A: No — we can set up GoHighLevel or a simpler CRM as part of the project, then build the automations on top.

### Website Redesign & Migration — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/website-redesign-migration

A fresh look without losing what works — redesigns and platform moves with zero ranking or content loss.

Q: Will I lose my Google rankings?
A: No — redirect mapping and SEO preservation are built into every redesign and migration, with checks after launch.

Q: Can you move my site to a different platform?
A: Yes — WordPress, Wix, Shopify, Squarespace and custom stacks are all in scope, with content migrated intact.

Q: How long does a redesign take?
A: Most redesigns take 3–6 weeks depending on page count and whether a platform move is included.

### Code Review & Technical Audit — https://thejimmylab.vercel.app/services/code-review-technical-audit

A senior, independent look at your codebase — what is solid, what is risky, and what to fix first.

Q: How is this different from your consultation code reviews?
A: Consultation reviews happen inside a 1:1 session. This is a standalone, documented audit of the whole codebase with a written report and roadmap.

Q: Do you need access to our code?
A: Yes — read-only repository access is enough, under NDA if you need one.

Q: Can you fix what you find?
A: Yes — fixes can be quoted as a follow-up project, or your team can work from the report directly.
